prerequisites: Named supported Linux NVIDIA GPU/compiler target with exact matched PyTorch/CUDA/driver/kernel locks. Mac CPU is not this route. No remote worker, model, compiler or service is provisioned implicitly. Other accelerator backends require their own source-compatible target lock.
lock_resolution: Fetch and check out only this exact commit in a private owned build prefix. Resolve explicit source build-system requirements to a hash lock, build one wheel without build isolation, verify its distribution metadata, resolve runtime dependencies to a second hash lock, sync with required hashes. Retain source/wheel/interpreter/uv identity and all environment file hashes. Repeat commissioning verifies the existing lock without resolving upgrades.
invoke: From a bounded project: nstack run P162 python -- /absolute/project/script.py [arguments]. Use only the registered package API, actual task inputs and current project permissions.
check: nstack check P162 python (actual import and distribution identity only). Then execute the distinct output, negative control and independent comparison from the component acceptance checks; import success is not domain acceptance.
deactivate: Each script exits normally; stop only a task-owned service started by that script after reconciling effects. nstack remove-runtime P162 python quarantines the exact owned environment and lock into private recovery. No global registration is created.
task_prerequisites: Matched accelerator drivers, PyTorch and engine dependencies; model memory
task_acceptance: Compare same checkpoint/precision/prompt lengths/concurrency with SGLang; require output parity and target p95 latency/throughput within VRAM limit.
Use inspected CLI vllm serve, bind explicitly, test cancellation, health and restart; no arbitrary trust_remote_code.
service_activation: After source build, inspect the locked CLI --help, bind an explicit local weight path/revision/hash, host127.0.0.1, port, context/concurrency and time budget. Use the built vllm serve or sglang launch_server entry point only for the named task. Run fixed-output, cancellation and load controls; stop the owned process and reconcile actual served acknowledgements. Import health does not establish GPU/service acceptance.
